## Purpose and issue
Closes #

## Scope / changed documents
Describe changed requirements, ADRs, contracts, or evidence.

## Provenance and rationale
Specify primary sources; label NOT RECOVERED where appropriate.

## Impact and proof obligations
List dependent mathematics, experiment protocols, tests, review gates, and reverse links.

## Validation
- [ ] Documentation checks pass
- [ ] Local links and ADR identifiers checked
- [ ] No release/version numbers introduced into document filenames
- [ ] No original recovery or append-only ADR history silently overwritten
- [ ] No unsupported claims, invented evidence, or unverifiable results
- [ ] Gate-1 status and implementation restrictions respected

## Reviewer findings and closure
Record independent review evidence where mandated. A PR approval is not automatically Gate-1 closure.
